integrity: The analytic argument proves the asymptotic theorem; finite numerical checker is only corroboration. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp law only for coordinate-delocalized orthant-spherical evaluation sequences; it gives a global lower bound, not a global sharp norm, and does not classify spiked evaluations or finite-dimensional extremizers.
title: Diffuse norming law for affine projection on positive spherical orthants
